newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUDAPEST BOURSE TO DISCUSS KEKKETI APPLY ON NOV 4.
newsitem.headline: BUDAPEST BOURSE TO DISCUSS KEKKETI APPLY ON NOV 4.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange's (BSE) council will discuss at its next regular meeting on November 4 the listing application of mineral water bottler and distributor Kekkuti Asvanyviz Rt, the BSE said.
Kekkuti submitted its application on October 24 for the listing of its shares in the listed B category (formerly called traded category).
